tasks.label: Validate Martyr Module
tasks.command: Get-ChildItem -Recurse | Where-Object { $_.Extension -in '.json', '.js', '.css' } | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "Checking: $($_.FullName)"; if ($_.Extension -eq '.json') { try { Get-Content $_.FullName | ConvertFrom-Json | Out-Null; Write-Host "✅ Valid JSON" -ForegroundColor Green } catch { Write-Host "❌ Invalid JSON: $_" -ForegroundColor Red } } }
